dog.description_text:
Named after the one and only Aang from Avatar: The Last Airbender, this seven-month-old black kitten may not be able to bend the elements, but she certainly has the power to steal hearts!

Aang came to ARF from Sag Harbor as part of our Operation Cat program, and now this little airbender is ready for her next great adventure: finding a forever home. Aang is waiting to bring some magic, mischief, and lots of love into your life.
